answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 2574 Country: India Title: How long was the qailulah of nabi (saw)? Question: How long was the qailulah of nabi (saw)? Answer ID: 2574 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 727/711=L) Qailulah (siesta) means sleeping or taking rest for awhile after lunch. I could not find out how long the Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) used to do it, most probably it depended upon the need and varied as per the season. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
